# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Image testing and rendering correctness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image-comparison tools and fixes runtime uniforms, texture sampling and Windows image-decoding crashes. The separate SkiaSharp.Testing package supports configurable image acceptance and difference diagnostics. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged in this line.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move away from packaged Linux x86 native assets** — Linux x86 native binaries are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Apps relying on those assets must move to a supported architecture when upgrading to this line. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))

## API Surface

- **Experimental image comparison package** — SkiaSharp.Testing adds SKImageComparison for SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap, with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, error metrics and difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in by suppressing SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; returned difference images are caller-owned. ([#5293](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5293))

## Bug Fixes

- **Predictable runtime-effect uniforms** — New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers start zeroed rather than containing leftover memory. Reset clears the existing buffer in place, avoiding a native-buffer and wrapper allocation on each call. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast) ([#5843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5843))
- **Windows x64 decoder error recovery** — Fixes crashes in clang-built Windows x64 natives when libjpeg or libpng recovers from decoding errors. This also fixes PDF output with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Other architectures and MSVC builds are unchanged. — ❤️ [@SimonCropp](https://github.com/SimonCropp) ([#5827](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5827))
- **Ganesh texture-subset sampling** — Keeps bilinear samples inside texture subsets and avoids an unsafe direct-copy path at logical texture edges. Edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected by this sampling option. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))
- **Tizen CPU blur selection** — Applies the intended CPU blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change. ([#5679](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5679))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 fixes** — Refreshes the bundled engine with upstream fixes within the Skia m159 milestone, without changing managed bindings. ([#5841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5841))
